scope: PostgreSQL enum-array generate_subscripts type-resolution and value contract under a shadowed search_path
findings: An untyped generate_subscripts($1, 1) call returns PostgreSQL SQLSTATE 42804 because the polymorphic array type cannot be determined.
The SQLSTATE differs from unnest($1), which returns 42725; both need a typed array argument in this context.
assertions: A schema-qualified target enum-array cast works while a same-named shadow enum leads search_path.
Native and bound results agree for both array dimensions and forward/reverse order, including non-default lower bounds.
Empty and SQL NULL arrays match native subscript results and remain distinct through type and array_send checks.
Empty, literal NULL, SQL NULL, Unicode and comma-containing enum labels retain exact array wire bytes.
A shadow-only enum label is rejected with native SQLSTATE 22P02.
